clauses.text: A human-origin fact or decision first supplied inside an external-agent conversation does not become HUMAN or HUMAN_DECISION authority merely because the agent reports it. The application presents the exact extracted value for direct confirm or correct without requiring retyping. Information already present in current raw input or accepted human records is not reconfirmed.

clauses.text: Every registered operation declares named input ports, output ports, exact types, cardinalities, deterministic error codes, error propagation, and resource-cost category. Each operation declares exact input arity and types and one normalized output type. Multi-artifact branches use explicit step references. BYTE_COMPARE and COMPARE receive explicit left and right inputs. Assertions receive explicit actual and expected inputs. A failed or unknown predecessor prevents dependent execution and propagates the registered terminal disposition without partial canonical result; errors propagate as typed execution failure and no later step may consume a failed output. Intermediate step outputs exist only for the current execution unless explicitly emitted as observations or evidence.

The application validates these values against the test role and proof obligation and derives when execution is due.

clauses.text: Every conditional activation proposition has either its own current PROOF_OBLIGATION_ID or an explicitly identified activation leaf inside the parent applicability proof contract. It uses the same proof-expression, observation, entailment, evidence-class, allowed-epistemic-basis, freshness, contradiction, independence, and semantic-review rules as every other release-bearing proposition.

clauses.text: Every release-bearing proposition, applicability condition, independence condition, entailment conclusion, source-authenticity conclusion, environment claim, and external-capability claim carries truthValue TRUE, FALSE, or UNKNOWN; epistemicBasis APPLICATION_OBSERVED, VERIFIED_EXTERNAL, EXTERNALLY_SUPPORTED, SELF_ASSERTED, or NONE; currentScopeStatus CURRENT or STALE; freshnessStatus CURRENT, EXPIRED, UNKNOWN, or NOT_APPLICABLE; contradictionStatus CLEAR or CONTRADICTED; reasons; supportingEvidenceIds; and a derivation or accepted semantic-review identity.
clauses.reason: This clause defines required ownership, behavior, boundaries, or acceptance conditions despite lacking the mechanical extractor keywords.

clauses.text: The closed proof-expression language permits LEAF, ALL_OF, ANY_OF, and AT_LEAST_K only. It has no arbitrary code, unrestricted negation, implicit coercion, stale references, or empty operators. ALL_OF is TRUE when all children are TRUE, FALSE when any is FALSE, and UNKNOWN otherwise. ANY_OF is TRUE when any is TRUE, FALSE when all are FALSE, and UNKNOWN otherwise. AT_LEAST_K is TRUE when trueCount ≥ K, FALSE when trueCount + unknownCount < K, and UNKNOWN otherwise.
clauses.reason: This clause defines required ownership, behavior, boundaries, or acceptance conditions despite lacking the mechanical extractor keywords.

clauses.text: Every normalizer and application derivation has an immutable registry ID, version, implementation-owner file, canonical input contract, output contract, hash or build identity, and invalidation consequences.
